# Model licences

<!-- Generated by docs/tools/notices.py from engine/src/cover_maker/data/catalog.yaml. -->

Cover_Maker does **not** distribute AI model weights. Each model is
downloaded from its original source only after you read and accept its
terms on the Models page; the acceptance is recorded with a hash of the
notice. This page lists what the catalogue says about each model, as
verified on the date shown. It is not legal advice: check the source
before relying on a model, especially for commercial use.

| Model | Licence class | Terms | Source | Verified |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BS-RoFormer SW (6 stems) | none | No licence published. It was rehosted by jarredou, who says he did not train it and has no provenance information; his account no longer exists. ([details](https://huggingface.co/elicwhite/bs-roformer-sw-6stem-onnx)) | <https://github.com/nomadkaraoke/python-audio-separator/releases/download/model-configs/BS-Roformer-SW.ckpt> | 2026-11-03 |
| BS-RoFormer Resurrection (vocals, unwa) | none | No licence published by the author (unwa); the repository has no licence tag, model card or licence file. ([details](https://huggingface.co/pcunwa/BS-Roformer-Resurrection)) | <https://huggingface.co/pcunwa/BS-Roformer-Resurrection> | 2026-11-03 |
| Mel-Band RoFormer vocals (Kimberley Jensen) | permissive | MIT, declared in the author's model card metadata; the repository has no separate licence file. ([details](https://huggingface.co/KimberleyJSN/melbandroformer/blob/main/README.md)) | <https://huggingface.co/KimberleyJSN/melbandroformer> | 2026-11-03 |
| BS-RoFormer karaoke (lead/backing vocals, anvuew) | copyleft | GPL-3.0, declared in the author's model card metadata. The card credits the training dataset to becruily; its contents are not published. ([details](https://huggingface.co/anvuew/karaoke_bs_roformer/blob/main/README.md)) | <https://huggingface.co/anvuew/karaoke_bs_roformer> | 2026-11-11 |
| Hybrid Transformer Demucs (4 stems) | non-commercial | Code is MIT; the author stated in 2022 that the weights are not covered by the MIT licence and are for personal or research use only (trained on research-only data). ([details](https://github.com/facebookresearch/demucs/issues/327#issuecomment-1134828611)) | <https://github.com/facebookresearch/demucs> | 2026-11-03 |
| Hybrid Transformer Demucs (6 stems) | non-commercial | Code is MIT; the author stated in 2022 that the weights are not covered by the MIT licence and are for personal or research use only (trained on research-only data). ([details](https://github.com/facebookresearch/demucs/issues/327#issuecomment-1134828611)) | <https://github.com/facebookresearch/demucs> | 2026-11-03 |

Licence classes: *permissive* (open licence allowing commercial use),
*non-commercial*, *copyleft*, *disputed* (conflicting statements) and
*none* (no licence published: all rights reserved by default).
